name: liquid-background
title: Liquid Background
blurb: GPU-rendered liquid waves using WebGL shaders and OGL.
description: WebGL-based liquid effect using vertex and fragment shaders. Creates flowing, wavy animation through procedural noise and trigonometric waves.
use_when: A cutting-edge, performance-intensive background for high-spec environments or special showcase sections.
avoid_when: Low-end or mobile devices — requires WebGL support and significant GPU resources. May not render in headless capture…
a11y: WebGL canvas overlay; focus and keyboard behaviour come from overlaid content.
